Title: Schedule / Calendar board
Description: As a dispatcher I want a calendar board (Daily/Week/Month) with map and slot-based job creation so that I can plan technicians' day efficiently.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Daily/Week/Month views
  • Read-only dispatch map (Daily)
  • Create job from empty slot
  • Jump to today via date click

Title: Switch calendar views & configure slot granularity
Description: As a dispatcher I want to switch between Daily / Week / Month views so that I can see scheduled jobs at different levels of detail.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Three views available: Daily, Week, Month; active view is visually indicated.
  • Job cards render on the board in every view.
  • Slot granularity configurable: 15 min / 30 min / 1 hour; changing it re-renders the time grid.
  • Chosen granularity persists.

Title: Jump to today by clicking the date
Description: As a dispatcher, after navigating to other days, I want to quickly return to today so that I don't lose my place.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Clicking the current date label returns the board to today.
  • No separate Today button (legacy design deprecated, not built).
  • Works in all three views (returns to the day/week/month containing today).

Title: Read-only dispatch map under the board (Daily only)
Description: As a dispatcher I want to see where the selected day's jobs are geographically so that I can reason about technician routes and avoid scheduling visits on opposite ends of town.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Map renders only in Daily view, below the board.
  • Pin markers for the selected day's jobs; coordinates derived from job address (= client address).
  • Markers colored by technician and numbered by visit order (1st, 2nd, 3rd).
  • Read-only: no drag-and-drop, no route building/optimization in MVP; zoom in/out only.
  • Stays in sync with the board: date/status/filter changes recompute markers.
  • Jobs outside working hours and unscheduled jobs are not shown.
  • On init, auto-fit zoom so all of the day's jobs fit in view.

Title: Create a job from an empty slot
Description: As a dispatcher I want to click an empty slot, pick a technician, and create a job immediately (e.g. during a client call) so that I don't have to hunt for a separate full form.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Clicking an empty slot opens the Create Job form, prefilled.
  • Prefilled: Start date + Start time (from the slot), Assigned To (slot technician), Schedule toggle = ON.
  • Mandatory: Client (dropdown), Service/Job Type, Job Frequency (One-off / Recurring).
  • Job Duration defaults from Job Type (2h default; Installation = 8h); configurable per client.
  • End time auto-fills from duration and is bidirectional (duration changes end time and vice versa).
  • Arbitrary time entry allowed (not only :00/:30, e.g. 10:25).
  • Out-of-range warning: if job falls outside working hours (default 7:00-17:00, configurable in Settings) a warning modal appears; it does not block, only confirms.
  • Overlap check: while setting start/end, dynamically check the technician's other jobs and show an inline error at the bottom on conflict.
  • On save: status = Scheduled and the job renders immediately on the chosen slot.

Title: Job Type as its own entity with custom types
Description: Backend/data-model spike: model Job Type as its own entity/table supporting custom types (MVP).
Acceptance Criteria:
• Job Type entity defined with custom types.
  • Default duration per type (Installation = 8h, others = 2h).

Title: Store geocoordinates + full address
Description: Backend spike supporting the dispatch map: persist coordinates and full address derived from client address.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Coordinates persisted per job/client.
  • Used by the Daily dispatch map markers.

Title: Decide start/end date column shape
Description: Data-model decision: store start/end date as one column or two.
Acceptance Criteria: • Decision documented and applied to the schema.

Title: Address autocomplete on Client Create
Description: Enhancement: address autocomplete when creating a client (feeds job coordinates/address).
Acceptance Criteria:
• Autocomplete suggests addresses on Client Create.
  • Selected address yields coordinates for the map.
